Action type codes

act_type_codes.Rd

Meanings of the msg_type and act_type code pairs used in the play-by-play data.

Usage

act_type_codes

Format

A tibble with one row per code pair:

msg_type

Event type code.

act_type

Sub-type code within that event type.

description

What the code means.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
load_pbp(2025) |>
  dplyr::left_join(act_type_codes, by = c("msg_type", "act_type"))
} # }
